connection_providers.name: primary
connection_providers.summary: The preferred destination of the host's own SSH entry; always tried first and never carries a priority. `stado network up` makes it the host's Stado network address, <host>.stado.internal.

connection_providers.name: lan
connection_providers.summary: The address the host answers on inside its own local network: its multicast DNS name or a private address.

connection_providers.name: direct
connection_providers.summary: A public address or name the host answers SSH on without any overlay.

connection_providers.name: tailscale
connection_providers.summary: The host's Tailscale address, reachable wherever both machines are signed into the same tailnet. An outside provider: optional, never required.

connection_providers.name: nebula
connection_providers.summary: The host's address on a Nebula overlay the operator runs. An outside network: optional, never required.

connection_providers.name: wireguard
connection_providers.summary: The host's address inside a WireGuard tunnel the operator runs. An outside network: optional, never required.
